# Open Sans

`assets/fonts/OpenSans.ttf` is the unmodified Open Sans variable font
(`OpenSans[wdth,wght].ttf`), Copyright 2020 The Open Sans Project Authors,
under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OpenSans-OFL.txt`).

* Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/e7db6ca603fd4862010383ff17ffd6cc4ffac1c0/ofl/opensans
* Upstream project: https://github.com/googlefonts/opensans
* SHA-256: `36643644f318a812aab2d2ed3bb98f8cf0872527f835fe9398d95fe6b9adb878`

The menus use its Regular (400), SemiBold (600) and Bold (700) weights through
Godot's FontVariation; the font file itself is not changed.

# VCR OSD Mono

`assets/fonts/VCR_OSD_MONO.ttf` is the unmodified `VCR_OSD_MONO_1.001.ttf`
(version 1.001, 31 March 2015) by Riciery Leal (MrManet), used for the green
VCR on-screen text drawn on videos.

* Source: https://www.dafont.com/vcr-osd-mono.font (download retrieved 23 October 2026)
* SHA-256: `01918d86cb163a715dcb97165b997256734dfcc9f550beeb7c142fa4a064cf1c`
* Terms: dafont lists the font as "100% Free", and a comment on the dafont
  page states it is fully free to use. The download contains only the font
  file, with no licence text.

# DotGothic16

Copyright 2020 The DotGothic16 Project Authors, under the SIL Open Font
License 1.1 (`DotGothic16-OFL.txt`). The menus use it for their 16-bit look.

* Upstream project: https://github.com/fontworks-fonts/DotGothic16
